questions.question: What is the difference between a Python list and a tuple?
questions.answer: A list is mutable, meaning its elements can be modified after creation. A tuple is immutable. Lists are generally used for collections that need modification, while tuples are useful for fixed collections.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Pandas in Python?
questions.answer: Pandas is a data analysis library that provides Series and DataFrame structures. It is useful for loading, cleaning, transforming and analyzing structured data.

questions.question: How would you build a machine learning workflow for predicting candidate-job matching?
questions.answer: I would first collect candidate and job description data. Then I would clean the text, extract relevant features and represent skills using suitable numerical techniques. I would train and validate a model using appropriate evaluation metrics. Finally, I would integrate the model into a Python API and monitor its predictions.
